summary: Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed (auth login admin+staff, /auth/me, clock in/out/history, holidays balance + request + admin decision, shifts create/list + swap, drive folder + file upload/download with base64 round-trip, forms template + submission + AI summarize via Emergent LLM Claude Sonnet 4.5). Frontend: Login screen renders, admin login redirects to /home tabs successfully; Home shows clock-in CTA, holidays card, today's shifts, quick actions; Profile tab loads showing user, holiday balance (25/0/25), Admin Panel and Sign Out buttons. All 5 tabs (Home/Schedule/Drive/Forms/Profile) navigate without crash. No red-screen errors.
action_items: Add testID props to login inputs and button (email-input, password-input, login-button) and to bottom tab items (tab-home, tab-schedule, tab-drive, tab-forms, tab-profile) for more reliable automated testing. Currently tests fall back to text/index selectors.
CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False; fine for Bearer-token auth but tighten origins for production.
server.py line 268 has a confusing nested expression for duration calc - works but should be simplified.
server.py is ~715 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, clock, holidays, shifts, drive, forms) per code-review guideline (>700 lines).
critical_code_review_comments: All endpoints use /api prefix correctly via APIRouter
MongoDB _id properly excluded via serialize() helper
JWT secret read from env, bcrypt hashes ($2b$ format), seed_admin updates password if changed - matches auth playbook
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env (not hardcoded)
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed holiday request, shift+swap, drive folder/file, form template+submission. Not cleaned up but isolated by prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use BASE = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_staffhub_api.py. AI summarize endpoint takes ~5-10s.
